tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma dam pa sangs rgyas kyi lugs yang dag pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la mngon par btud de/ snang ba rten 'brel du shar ba dam pa sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma bya bar 'dod na/ sngon mi rgan bza' mi gnyis yod pas/ rgad po na nas rgad mos dam pa la zhus pa/ dam pa rin po che bdag gi khyo pho na nas de la phan pa'i gtor ma zhig zhu zhus pas/ dam pa'i zhal nas rgad po ci na gsungs pa/ rgan mos 'byung bzhi cha ma snyoms pas na zhus pas/ dam pas 'byung bzhi cha ma snyoms pas na na 'byung bzhi gtor ma bya dgos gsungs nas 'di mdzad/ des mi rgan nad las grol lo// de'i rim pa ni/ gtor snod rin po cher gtor ma dang po rlung gi rang bzhin zla gam/ gnyis pa me'i rang bzhin gru gsum/ gsum pa chu'i rang bzhin zlum po/ bzhi pa sa'i rang bzhin gru bzhi rnams re rer mtheb skyu re dang bcas bshams/ snod lnga par glud dang ting lo chang bu mtheb skyu dang bcas pa bshams la chus sbyangs te/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ mṛ tas bsangs| swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang nyid skad cig gis dam pa sangs rgyas sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas seng ldeng gi ḍā ma ru nam mkha' la 'khrol ba/ g.yon dngul dkar gyi dril bu dkur brten pa| rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba/ rten 'brel gyi gal ta phrag pa la bkal ba/ zhal nas ā di kā di'i sgra sgrog pa/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag gi dgongs pa ma lus pa thugs la gsal ba zhig tu gyur par dmigs te/ brgyud pa'i gdams pa ma lus 'dzin mdzad pa// ka ma la shī la'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon po dang*// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dug lnga rang sar zhi nas ye shes lnga rgyud la 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ a ā/

i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsum bzlas/ slar yang bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma yaṃ las rlung rdzas zla gaṃ sngon po yangs shing g.yo ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ yaṃ tsa tsha dza dzña nya yaṃ i ī zhes ci nus kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhaṃ| nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod la/ gtor ma rlung rdzas sngon po 'di nyid/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'/ yi dam rdo rje sems dpa'/ mkha' 'gro rdo rje sems dpa'/ chos skyong rdo rje sems dpa'/ shar rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// rnal 'byor pa'i snang ba rten 'brel du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rten 'brel gyi sgo nas 'gro ba sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ khyad par du nyon mongs pa/ zhe sdang*/ nad rlung las gyur pa/ gdon lha yi gdon/ shar phyogs dri za'i gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ zhi ba'i phrin las ma lus pa 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ gnyis pa bsangs sbyangs sogs gong ltar la/ gtor ma raṃ las me rdzas gru gsum dmar po tsha zhing sreg pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ raṃ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa raṃ ṛ ṝ zhes ci nus kyi mthar/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ gtor ma me rdzas dmar po 'di nyid/ bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan/ yi dam rin chen 'byung ldan/ mkha' 'gro rin chen 'byung ldan/ chos skyong rin chen 'byung ldan/ lho rin chen 'byung ldan gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// rnal 'byor pa'i snang ba rten 'brel du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

rten 'brel gyi sgo nas 'gro ba sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa nga rgyal/ nad tsha ba dang mkhris pa las gyur pa/ gdon pho gdon rgyal po/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa'i phrin las ma lus pa 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ gsum pa yang bsangs sbyangs gong ltar la/ gtor ma baṃ las chu rdzas zlum po dkar po rlan zhing gsher ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ baṃ pa pha ba bha ma baṃ u ū/ zhes ci nus kyi mthar/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gtor ma chu rdzas dkar po 'di nyid/ bla ma snang ba mtha' yas/ yi dam snang ba mtha' yas/ mkha' 'gro snang ba mtha' yas/ chos skyong snang ba mtha' yas/ nub snang ba mtha' yas lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// rnal 'byor pa'i snang ba rten 'brel du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rten 'brel gyi sgo nas 'gro ba sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa 'dod chags/ nad khrag dang grang ba las gyur pa/ gdon mo gdon rgyal mo/ nub phyogs klu dbang gi gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ dbang gi phrin las ma lus pa 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bzhi pa yang bsangs sbyangs gong ltar la/ gtor ma laṃ las sa rdzas gru bzhi ser po sra zhing brtan pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ laṃ ta tha da dha na laṃ l̥ l̥̄/ zhes ci nus kyis mthar/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gtor ma sa rdzas ser po 'di nyid/ bla ma don yod grub pa/ yi dam don yod grub pa/ mkha' 'gro don yod grub pa/ chos skyong don yod grub pa/ byang don yod grub pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// rnal 'byor pa'i snang ba rten 'brel du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol| rten 'brel gyi sgo nas 'gro ba sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa 'grub par mdzad du gsol/

khyad pa du yang nyon mongs pa phrag dog /nad bad kan las gyur pa/ gdon sa bdag gi gdon/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin gyi gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ drag po'i phrin las ma lus pa 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ de nas glud chus sbyangs la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ ngar glud gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur par dmigs te/ saṃ bha ra ci nus dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod la/ slar yang*/ a kā ro ci nus kyi mthar/ gtor glud 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di ni bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i gnod byed lan chags 'byung po thams cad la sbyin no// bdag cag gi nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo// de nas glud btang ba ni/ kyai/ srid gsum 'di na gang yang rung*| |gnod par byed pa'i gnod bgegs rnams// tshur gshegs rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon// ro mchog ngar glud ya mtshan can// phyi nas bltas na dar dang zab// nang nas bltas na gser dang dngul// gsang ba ye shes lnga dang ldan// sngon tshe lha dbang brgya byin glud// bar du btsad po khri srong glud// da lta rnal 'byor bdag gi glud// ces par/ nad pa sogs gzhan gyi don yin na/ da lta rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag glud// ces kha bsgyur// rnam shes tshogs brgyad skye mched drug /dbang po lnga dang don snying lnga// ma tshang ba ni gang yang med// dga' zhing spro bas 'di khyer cig |yas kyi bdag pos yas longs shig /glud kyi bdag mos glud longs shig /bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyi// sha yi glud 'di sa la gtong*// sa la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// bdag la zhes par/ gzhan don yin na/ 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig /ces bsgyur/ de bzhin rkang pa 'og ma gsum kun la sbyar te/

khrag gi glud 'di chu la gtong*// chu la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig /rus pa'i glud 'di brag la gtong*| |brag la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig /drod kyi glud 'di me la gtong*// me la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams| |glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig /dbugs kyi glud 'di rlung la gtong*// rlung la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig /nang khrol glud 'di 'phrang la gtong*// 'phrang la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig /skra dang ba spu'i glud 'di shing la gtong*// shing la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig /sems kyi glud 'di nam mkhar gtong*// nam mkhar gnas pa'i lha 'dre'i tshogs// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// bdag la gnod pa ma byed cig /de bas lha srin sde brgyad rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// khram la bab na khram kha phyes// rtsis la bab na rtsis kha phyung*// rgyan la bab na rgyan 'di spos// sho la bab na sho rde'u gtor// bzung pa thong la bcing ba khrol| |chags che nyam nga bzlog gyur cig /phyi yi 'byung ba bzhi dbang du 'dus par gyur cig /nang gi 'byung ba bzhi ro snyoms par gyur cig /gsang ba'i 'byung ba bzhi mngon du 'gyur bar gyur cig /sprul sku dam pa sangs rgyas kyis ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin// rnal 'byor pa bdag gi bden pa'i tshig 'di'ang 'grub par gyur cig /ces gtor glud rnams gtsang sar phul la/ bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o// de ltar 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma'i rim pa 'di yang sprul sku dam pa sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa nyid gtsor bzhag ste/

dpe kha gcig tu 'byung ba'i khams kyi gsal byed kyi sde pa nor 'dug pa rnams bcos te dag par bsdebs pa 'di'ang*/ dus mtha'i snyoms las mkhan shākya'i dge slong 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas/ chu mo phag lo smin drug zla ba'i nyer drug la gzhu spro lung gi yang thog tu sbyar ba maṅga laṃ// //
